nodes.label: POST /email/resend-rfq-by-vendor/{rfq_number}/{vendor_batch}/{vendor_code} - Resend RFQ to Specific Vendor
nodes.rationale: Adds a request body carrying source_vendor_code and source_vendor_batch so items already quoted under one vendor batch can be re-targeted at a different vendor, which the plain resend-request-for-quotation variant cannot express.

edges.source_location: table_data.server_groups and vendor_server_groups carry the BCG/GEMS values enumerated by the Auto PO server list
